ruleSketch: products/**: ban experiment filters with start_date__isnull=False, end_date__isnull=True; use Experiment.is_running
note: Reuse Experiment.is_running instead of an inline running-experiment filter. is_running existed, but banning one ORM kwarg combo is a PR-specific rule no team would declare.
Merge a separate paths-filter exclude step into the step above in a CI workflow. Structural judgment, no declarable rule.
Fetch the team API token lazily in the branches that emit, or push the fetch into the emitter. Placement judgment, no nameable banned token.

ruleSketch: nodejs/src/ingestion/** may not import from ~/cdp/**; depend on ~/common/* interfaces instead
note: Ingestion step imported HogTransformerService from cdp; fix imports the common hog-transformer interface, which existed at before. no-restricted-imports expresses it.

ruleSketch: products/signals/**: ban OrganizationMembership.objects; use User.teams for membership checks
note: Use User.teams rather than querying OrganizationMembership. OrganizationMembership is legitimately used widely, so a ban would not be declared up front.

ruleSketch: frontend/src/**: ban hand-written offset/next pagination loops; use api.loadPaginatedResults
note: Replace a hand-rolled pagination loop with the existing api.loadPaginatedResults. Recognising a pagination loop needs meaning, and it is a nit a team would not declare.
Consolidate Redshift COPY error handling into RedshiftClient.acopy_from_s3_bucket rather than splitting it. The located fix only drops a comment.

ruleSketch: frontend/src/**: new component identifiers must not contain Max (product name); use AI
note: Rename a new MaxToolWrapper component after PostHog AI. Max is still used across components and the reviewer is unsure; Max vs max needs meaning.

ruleSketch: products/*/mcp/tools.yaml: analytics query tools must be named query-<x>
note: Name the analytics span query tool query-*. Deciding whether a tool is an analytics query needs judgment of meaning, not its YAML shape.
Enforce the full-graph requirement for activation in HogFlowSerializer validation instead of documenting the exception in the MCP tool description.
Define the token character set once in production code and reference it from the test instead of repeating it.
Pick a more descriptive name for the batch queue tables. Naming quality is judgment.
Replace a one-off HogQLContext flag that swaps events for sharded_events with a database extension that modifies the table. Mechanism choice.
Extract is_cloudflare_configured into cloudflare.py and share it; the helper is created by the fix, so nothing existed to point at.

ruleSketch: posthog/hogql/printer/access_control.py: ban ast.Constant for guard values; use bound placeholders
note: Bind blocked ids as query parameters instead of injecting constants into the AST. Rule scoped to one file; located fix does not change the constant.
Keep alerting destinations code in one place, the alerting product, rather than split between common and posthog. Ownership judgment.

ruleSketch: products/**/frontend: ban .percentage_usage access; use billingLogic.isProductOverUsageLimit
note: Reuse billingLogic.isProductOverUsageLimit instead of a hand-written usage check. The selector existed, but a percentage_usage ban is PR-specific.

ruleSketch: frontend/src/lib/hog-charts/**: ban identifiers matching /AxisTitle/; use AxisLabel
note: Rename xAxisTitle helpers to xAxisLabel to match chart code naming. A consistency rename, not a term a team would ban up front.
Rename the ingestionwarnings lane and pipeline to clientwarnings. Clarity rename of one concept, no banned term.

ruleSketch: products/data_warehouse/backend/api/**: no ExternalDataSourceType.<member> branches; put source-specific logic in the source
note: Move Postgres-specific schema propagation out of the API controller into the source. Source-specific logic needs meaning; the after state still branches on POSTGRES.
Lift applied-credit and amount-due calculations into billingProductLogic selectors so all purchase surfaces share one number.
Reuse formatHourString and dayOptions from batch-exports utils instead of a hand-written 12-hour formatter and day list. Hand-rewritten logic, no shared token.

ruleSketch: posthog/temporal/session_replay/session_summary/summarize_session.py may not call capture_session_summary_ready
note: Emit summary-ready events only from the video-based summary path, not the legacy one. A ban scoped to one soon-removed file is not general.
Turn tracking-code signing into an injectable class that parses keys once, like RecipientTokensService. Mechanism choice.
Keep the generic list_entities signature free of entity-specific filters; expose a public list_feature_flags for the tool. API shape judgment.
Record dependency edges once during the DFS and read them later instead of rebuilding the adjacency.

ruleSketch: products/slack_app/**: feature flag key string constants (*_FLAG) must start with slack-app-
note: Slack app flag key used a posthog-code- prefix; feature_flags.py keys use slack-app-. Fix also renames log events and moves the check into feature_flags.py.
Move derivations out of the component into featureFlagTestingLogic selectors. Deciding what is business logic needs judgment.
Extract an _invalid_request_error helper for repeated 400 envelopes; the helper is created by the fix.
Centralize job and tracker creation logic that now lives in both the CDC activity and create_external_data_job_model_activity.

ruleSketch: ban posthog.capture in frontend/src/scenes/** (except eventUsageLogic); report analytics via eventUsageLogic report* actions
note: Raw posthog.capture calls in a logic should go through eventUsageLogic; eventUsageLogic existed but needed new report actions, and the fix also moved a date helper.
Same credential literal is hardcoded in config, its test, and a bash script; export the const and import it in the test.
A derived value computed in the component should be a selector in the Kea logic; no nameable banned construct.
Two call sites update the bucketing identifier with different action shapes; unify on one shape.

ruleSketch: ban piping Python into `manage.py shell` in bin/** scripts; add a management command instead
note: Inline Django shell heredoc should be a management command reusing the team-enable command; no other bin script does this, so a pre-declared ban is implausible.

ruleSketch: ban Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone in frontend/src and products/*/frontend; use getLocalTimeZone
note: Reviewer asked for a shared util for the local timezone; getLocalTimeZone did not exist in lib/utils/timezones at before, the fix created it.

ruleSketch: ban rdkafka::ClientConfig in rust/*/src/main.rs; build clients in the service's kafka module
note: Kafka consumer config built in main should move into the kafka module; a main.rs-scoped type ban is hindsight and clippy config is crate-wide.
Team routing logic was rewritten by hand though the dual-write output already has routing logic; located fix only changes the hash math.
A thin wrapper adds nothing over getUnhealthyProviderKey and misses a hog short-circuit; judgment about wrapper value and behaviour.

ruleSketch: ban api.query with HogQLQuery in products/mcp_analytics/frontend/**; use a backend endpoint
note: HogQL queries in a frontend logic should move to a backend endpoint; api.query is a standard frontend path and the endpoint was built by the fix.

ruleSketch: ban literal "us-east-1" defaults in posthog/settings/**; fall back to OBJECT_STORAGE_REGION
note: Region default should reuse OBJECT_STORAGE_REGION; hardcoded us-east-1 defaults are the norm across settings files, so no team would declare the ban.

ruleSketch: BREAKDOWN_*_STRING_LABEL only inside posthog/hogql_queries/**; use replace_breakdown_labels elsewhere
note: Hand-written sentinel replacement duplicates replace_breakdown_labels; the constants are legitimately imported in several modules, so the restriction is hindsight.

ruleSketch: steps/ dirs under nodejs/src/ingestion only at ingestion/common/steps/** or ingestion/pipelines/*/steps/**
note: Step file lived under a top-level ingestion/steps dir; both allowed homes existed at before, a path rule fires on the old path and clears after the move.
Two migrations added in one PR should be merged into one; depends on PR scope, not syntax.
Ingestion warning emission lives at the v0 endpoint but in analytics.rs for v1; asks to unify where it happens.

ruleSketch: ban 'sourcemap' in identifiers and paths under products/error_tracking/skills/**; use 'symbolset'
note: Prefer symbolset for generic concepts and rename the skill; sourcemap stays correct for the JS-only script, so a term ban is not general.
Same action tuple is a class attribute in team.py and an inline literal in project.py; hoist to module level and import it.

ruleSketch: posthog.api may not depend on products.*.dags
note: API module imported a constant from a Dagster dags module; the fix moved it into backend constants so the API no longer imports dags.

ruleSketch: in products/warehouse_sources/backend/** outside models, ban reading $S.sync_type_config; use ExternalDataSchema properties
note: Direct sync_type_config read should use a model property; the model wraps most keys in properties, but a new one had to be added.
Drop the Handle suffix from a DTO name for clarity; the term is not banned elsewhere.
Config/condition compatibility check re-implemented in the extractor duplicates save-time validation; remove the copy.
Per-team over-limit check repeats work already done by the team selection query; skip it when already known.
Module-level throttle helpers should become methods on a throttle class; a design judgment with no nameable ban.
New purchase modal forks the upgrade modal's table, footer, and copy; extract a shared confirmation component.
SDK info is extracted twice per request; thread the first result out instead of recomputing.
Two near-identical merge writer loops in the benchmark should become one helper.
Approval-required 409 handling is copied from featureFlagsLogic; extract a shared helper.
Derived state and change handlers computed in the component should move into the Kea logic as selectors and actions.
compose_stage2 should accept (leaf, person) pairs instead of synthesized placeholder transitions; a signature design choice.
Questions duplicating org counts onto person properties versus supporting group properties in Workflows; product and data design direction.
